import json
from work import evaluate
p={'defaults':{'enabled':True,'retries':3,'label':'x'},'types':{'enabled':'boolean','retries':'integer','label':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}
cases=[
({'layers':[{'enabled':False,'retries':0,'label':''}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':False,'retries':0,'label':''},'error':None}),
({'layers':[{'retries':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':True,'retries':3,'label':'x'},'error':None}),
({'layers':[{'extra':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),
({'environment':{'enabled':'false','retries':'-0','label':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':False,'retries':0,'label':''},'error':None}),
({'environment':{'enabled':'False'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'environment':{'retries':'+1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'environment':{'retries':' 1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'environment':{'retries':'1.0'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
({'layers':[{'retries':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
({'layers':[{'enabled':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
]
for i,(request,expected) in enumerate(cases):
 actual=evaluate(request,p)
 assert actual==expected,(i,actual,expected)
 assert set(actual)=={'ok','config','error'}
# Type checking occurs only after environment, so a bad layer can be repaired.
assert evaluate({'layers':[{'retries':'bad'}],'environment':{'retries':'2'}},p)=={'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':True,'retries':2,'label':'x'},'error':None}
# Disabled environment is not applied.
p2=dict(p,environment=False)
assert evaluate({'environment':{'extra':'x','retries':'bad'}},p2)=={'ok':True,'config':p['defaults'],'error':None}
print('boundary checks passed:',len(cases)+2)
